title: Ah! I Wish... Once More!
overview: After the fiasco involving the Lord of Terror, the Goddess Technical Helpline is missing important information including Keiichi Morisato's wish.

title: Ah! The Beleaguered Queen of Vengeance!
overview: With Christmas approaching, Sayoko Mishima desires to spend her time with the only man on campus who does not appear to "worship" her, that being Keiichi.

title: Ah! I Offer These Feelings on Christmas Eve!
overview: While Keiichi and Belldandy are working at the convenience store, the town is covered with the single color of Christmas. Keiichi, remembering that Belldandy has been with him for about a year decides to get her a present.

title: Ah! I Want to Fill the World with Happiness!
overview: Keiichi, Belldandy, and the others attend Sayoko's Christmas party.

title: Ah! Well-Matched Vibes of Love!
overview: Hikozaemon Otaki fixes the scooter of Satoko Yamano who is being harassed by Toshiyuki and falls in love with her.

title: Ah! Is That Jealouy?!
overview: Keiichi receives his first love letter from an underclassman

title: Ah! I Shall Grant Your Wish!
overview: Keiichi and Belldandy look at photos they have taken recently.

title: Ah! I Want to Be of Use to You!
overview: Ignoring Belldandy's feelings, Urd, Skuld, and Peorth compete to see which of them is most suited to serve Keiichi.

title: Ah! The Goddesses Go Head to Head on a Date!
overview: After reading a romantic comic book, Peorth wishes to go on a date with Keiichi.

title: Ah! I Just Can't Say It!
overview: Peorth continues to vie for Keiichi's affections while feeding him food she prepared.

title: Ah! Grasp Your Dream with Your Own Hands!
overview: Toraichi Tamiya and Otaki suddenly announce to the Auto Club that they have to leave town.

title: Ah! A Goddess's Tears and His Dream!
overview: Troubadour, the plum blossom spirit who once was Urd's lover, appears, urging to reunite with Urd.

title: Ah! Let Those Feelings Awaken
overview: After betting that Urd cannot ride a ride, Skuld is proven wrong, and thus relinquishes her ice cream as her wager.

title: Ah! My Darling Cupid!
overview: Skuld's feelings of affection towards Sentaro awakens her magical powers

title: Ah! I'm Half Goddess, Half Demon?!
overview: Marller surprisingly visits the onsen resort along with Keiichi, Belldandy, Urd, and Skuld.

title: Ah! Shimmer Without Fear of the Darkness!
overview: Belldandy philosophizes what would happen Urd's demon and goddess halves remain split, knowing that would cause Urd to self-destruct.

title: Ah! The Chair of Demonkind Descends!
overview: Even though Urd has reunified her halves, she bares a dissociative identity disorder, as her demon halves suffers memory loss.

title: Ah! Do Demons Have Any Dignity?!
overview: Hild pays a visit to a reminiscent Marller, who is dissatisfied of working at a convenience store.

title: Ah! The Love of a Goddess Saves the Ninja!
overview: Marller has revived three female rodent ninjas in another attempt to attack Belldandy.

title: Ah! It Doesn't Matter Where, So Long as We're Together!
overview: Everyone seems to show up asking to store items at the temple, creating a bit of a crush. In an effort to make more room, Skuld creates a device to double the storage space in a room.

title: Ah! Would It Be Okay If I Were a Demon?!
overview: After three days, Belldandy returns from heaven but discovers that she has been issued a demon license instead of a goddess license.

title: Ah! The Goddess's Confession!
overview: It is shown that Keiichi and Hild are lovers, confusing the three goddesses that Keiichi may be under demonic control.
